QuestInfo.name: Wave Translator
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 128,171\nCan proceed to Wave Translation quest\n
QuestInfo.0: Go to the #bCommand Center#k to find #bDr. Kim#k.
QuestInfo.1: When you told #p2050001# that you couldn't really extract any information out of #p2050002#, he said that he isn't surprised and instead wants to get information by intercepting their ultrasonic waves. He asked you to obtain materials to make a #b#t4031927##k. He says that they should be easy to get from the Grays in Kulan Field...
QuestInfo.2: #p2050001# made a #t4031927# once you brought all the materials.

0.0: The research indicates that the Grays communicate by emitting supersonic waves from their tentacles. These supersonic communications can apparently only communicate truth. If we can intercept these waves, we can learn all about the aliens!
0.1: Of course, it's no simple task to decode the waves. We still lack a lot of materials since the research is in its early stages. Before we can make a #b#t4031927##k, can you get me some materials to work with?
0.2: Of course, you can't just decode the waves. I'm still in the beginning stages of my research, so I need a number of materials to build a Wave Translator. Won't you find me the materials so I can build a #b#t4031927##k?

yes.0: It's simple. Just get me #b10 Gray Antenna#k. I should be able to make a #t4031927# based on extracts from those. Hunt the Grays in Kulan Field to get them.

no.0: Hmm... you seemed competent enough to get those things done easily...

1.0: Oh, you've brought all the materials I need. Give me a few moments. I will build you a Wave Translator.

item.0: We need more materials to make a #bWave Translator#k. Did you forget what they are? You need to bring me #b10 Gray Antenna#k. Not sure how you could forget something like that.
